title: <tool> update --check --json
description: SPEC §5, steps 1 to 4, reported. Exits 0 whether or not there's an update: scripts read `updateAvailable`.

current.description: This CLI's version, from its package.json.

tag.description: The dist-tag asked for, or null when --to named a version.

canUpdate.description: Whether `update` would install it itself (false means it exits 5).

command.description: What to run: `<tool> update`, or the right command when this install can't update itself.

nodeOk.description: This Node satisfies the target's engines.node.
